120923: The main protagonist. A biology teacher who is fascinated by demis and wants to learn more about them. He is occasionally referred to as "Iron Man" by his students, a pun on his bulky physique and his name.
120924: A highly energetic vampire. She usually avoids biting other people's necks, instead drinking blood packs sent by the government and using blood substitutes like tomato juice. Contrary to myths, she loves eating garlic and merely dislikes bright lights.
120925: A shy dullahan whose head is always detached from her body, which has a blue flame coming from where the neck should be. Since she can't move her head by herself, she is always longing for contact with others. She develops a crush on Tetsuo, due to his kind and caring nature.
120926: A timid snow woman whose body is always cold. She will sometimes spread cold air while experiencing negative emotions and is susceptible to heat.
120927: Hikari's twin sister, who is an ordinary human. She is much more serious than her sister, both as a person and a student. She often tries to make her sister act more mature, but is unable to.
120928: A succubus who works as a math teacher. Due to the aphrodisiac her body produces, she constantly has to take precautions to avoid inadvertently seducing her male students, such as wearing a tracksuit and taking early trains.
159080: A young German boy who is also a detective working under Ugaki. He is immune to the charms of succubi.
186383: A detective who works for the Demi-Human Crimes Division.
